name: Ruby notes API
description: A Sinatra API with SQL injection via string interpolation, path traversal, command injection, MD5 password hashing, insecure random, XSS, disabled TLS verification and hard-coded credentials. Intentionally insecure, for education.
expected: Findings from the Ruby token scanner.

fixes.title: Read secrets from environment variables
fixes.explanation: Credentials are no longer in the source; rotate any that were committed.

fixes.title: Use parameterised SQLite queries
fixes.explanation: Owner and search term are passed as bound parameters, not interpolated into the SQL text.
edits: DB.execute("SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE owner = '#{owner}'")
DB.execute('SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE owner = ?', owner)
DB.execute("SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE title LIKE '%#{term}%'")
DB.execute('SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE title LIKE ?', "%#{term}%")

fixes.title: Confine file reads to the notes directory
fixes.explanation: expand_path and a start_with? check prevent traversal above /srv/notes.
edits:
base = '/srv/notes'
  safe = File.expand_path(name, base)
  halt 400 unless safe.start_with?(base + '/')
  content = File.read(safe)

fixes.title: Escape the directory argument before the shell sees it
fixes.explanation: Shellwords.escape ensures the argument cannot contain shell metacharacters.

fixes.title: Use bcrypt for password verification
fixes.explanation: bcrypt is slow by design, defeating offline dictionary attacks after a leak.
edits:
hash = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(pw)
  user = DB.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE pw_hash = '#{hash}'").first
  user ? { ok: true }.to_json : halt(401)

user = DB.execute('SELECT id, pw_hash FROM users WHERE name = ?', params[:name]).first
  halt 401 unless user && BCrypt::Password.new(user[1]) == pw
  { ok: true }.to_json

fixes.title: Use SecureRandom for session tokens
fixes.explanation: SecureRandom draws from the OS entropy source and cannot be predicted.

fixes.title: HTML-escape the name before reflecting it
Leave TLS verification on
fixes.explanation: Certificate verification is on by default; the explicit VERIFY_NONE is removed.
edits: # TLS verification is on by default
